pyramiding_rule: Prohibit scaling into losing positions; only permit pyramiding when existing open positions have achieved at least +$5.00 in floating profit and structural breakout confirmation is validated.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 1.5 ATR buffer from current swing highs/lows for initial stop-loss placement, completely banning sub-0.5 dollar stops to eliminate noise-hunting.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation once profit crosses +$5.00 to protect gains and ensure asymmetrical runs extend toward the $15-$30 target window.
